votability: The current general meeting offers eligible shareholders a proxy ballot.
registration_required: The account must register its voting participation before it may cast votes.
beneficial_owner_disclosure_required: Voting is conditional on delivery of the beneficial owner name and identity details.
holding_confirmation_required: The voting agent requires documentary proof of the account holdings.
securities_lending_recall_required: Voting investors must bring lent shares back from the borrower before voting.
other_voting_restriction: The service accepts votes without imposing the additional professional-investor voting restriction.
